name: written-design-request
description: Implicit written-planning request loads design and reaches its three artifacts through scripted confirmations. Stage test-files as an isolated workspace, never in place under the hosting skill.
prompt: Write a design document, implementation plan, and task list for adding an archive command to the note tool described in README.md.
trap: Conversation-only brainstorming captures a request for written planning.

assertions.text: The competing-catalog trace loads $kk:design without loading $kk:brainstorm.
The conversation obtains HMW, persona, success, constraints, classification, direction, and design-presentation confirmations before drafting.
The run writes design.md, implementation.md, and tasks.md under docs/feat/wip/archive-command/, with linked plans and pending tasks.
The artifacts preserve visible archived items and unchanged content/links; the response reports planning rather than implemented behavior.
